title: The Race That Did Not Need a Loser
youtube_title: The Race That Did Not Need a Loser | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends can change the plan so both can play.
summary: At a ferry deck with a rail and two elbows of room, Bibi is just outside the fun, close to a race that could become a parade. Esme changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Bibi has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Neighbor Sami lets the children solve it.
